study_info.title: Effectiveness of an Interactive Virtual Telerehabilitation System in Patients after Total Knee Arthroplasty: A Randomized Controlled Trial
study_info.authors: Mercè Piqueras, Ester Marco, Maria Coll, Ferran Escalada, Alex Ballester, Carme Cinca, Roser Belmonte and Josep M. Muniesa
study_info.study_design: Randomized, controlled, single-blind clinical trial. Randomization method not specified.
study_info.inclusion_criteria: successful primary TKA surgery; post-TKA active range of motion: flexion 80º and extension –10º, without signs of stiffness; ability to walk with the use of a walking aid; ability to read and understand Spanish; ability to understand and accept the trial procedures and to sign an informed consent form in accordance with national legislation.
study_info.exclusion_criteria: sensory, cognitive and/or praxic impairment; concomitant medical conditions that may influence the rehabilitation process; discharge to destination other than home; patients with any local or systemic complication (e.g. surgical wound infection, suspicion of deep vein thrombosis) in the 3-month follow-up period were also excluded.
study_info.study_setting: rehabilitation unit in an acute-care university general hospital in Barcelona, Spain
study_info.source_of_recruitment: patients who underwent primary TKA in a tertiary hospital in the city of Barcelona, Spain

minimal_units.control_details: standard clinical protocol of TKA rehabilitation consisting of 1-h sessions for 10 days; conventional physical therapy consisted of a 2-week face-to-face rehabilitation programme (progressive exercise and instruction including knee range of motion, gait training, and instructions in negotiating stairs and community-related obstacles).

minimal_units.intervention_details: 1-h IVT sessions for 10 days (5 sessions performed under a therapist’s supervision and 5 sessions performed at home); IVT is an interactive virtual software-hardware platform with wireless sensors, interactive patient application, and therapist web portal; exercises included the same as conventional protocol.
minimal_units.intervention_frequency: 1-h daily sessions, Monday to Friday, for 2 weeks (10 sessions total)
